official_definition: Twinkle Necromancy (When Advents) You can summon Cost 0/1/3/6/9 Spirit cards, one of each Cost, from your Trash, without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Necromancy] or [Twinkle Necromancy: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Necromancy]", "give [Twinkle Necromancy]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
